_comment: Repo-safe conceptual MCP client config. Adapt the remote URL field to your client's custom-connector format. Never add OAuth tokens, refresh tokens, ServiceKeys, client secrets, or a real portal config to this file.

routingPolicy.remoteDefaultHubSpotScopes: reviewed read/write scopes, including confirmation-gated destructive CRM operations
notes: Call hsapi_remote_identity and hsapi_remote_capabilities before remote execution.
Use endpoint help for named operations; use raw method/path execution when the path maps to an exposed OAuth scope.
Use the local connector only for an authorized capability the remote manifest or current public-app grant does not provide.
Do not treat the local connector as an automatic fallback from an OAuth permission error.
